headline: IndiGo Cuts 10 International Destinations
summary: India's largest airline, IndiGo, has withdrawn from 10 international routes due to aircraft leasing issues and airspace restrictions.
why: IndiGo is a dominant player in the Indian aviation market; network reductions can impact revenue growth and operational efficiency.

impacts.name: IndiGo
impacts.why: Reduced network capacity may negatively impact future revenue.
